posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
I agree that more content for my pledge dollars is a huge motivator to back a Kickstarter.  I'd like to see the list of funding goals be pepped up with more stuff than just extra Station cards, a bigger box, and better minis (which definitely does not look like a slam dunk at this point).

  • Extra Sectors would be nice (maybe give people a hook so they are just dying to get them, like making one the Thorathian Sector or Hoth Sector or the Neutral Zone or something).
  • Maybe alternate versions of the ship panels with wicked flames or wings or jaws painted on the sides of the ships.
  • Alternate Opposition flagships should work just like alt SotM villains, so those should definitely be in the list.
  • Of course, extra ships (since they're only a panel and 8 cards) should be all over the list.

$20k spaces between rewards of a single new Station card seems like a tough road to get to $150k.

posts.name: Foote
posts.cooked:
Can't argue with any of that Spiff. I am sure >G would love to do all that as well, but lets keep a little perspective. It is still the sophomore effort of a small (but growing) company. While I agree the stretch rewards seem a little lackluster, I would think they want to save those bells and whistles for after the base game launches and they can take into account a much larger sample of player feedback of the game system.

I guess I am saying that I'm ok with things being kept simple. Too much too fast can be overwhelming for a game most ppl haven't played. Just my 2 cents

posts.name: Spiff
posts.cooked:
I don't know much about the games specifics or what station cards really are/do

That's why they're a kind of weak stretch goal.  If people don't know why they'd want to stretch to get them, their value as a goal is reduced.  I'm sure they'll be great to play with.  But their job right now is to motivate people to spend.

Besides, even if we get all 6 cards (x3 copies of each), they'll still just be 18 cards in the 90 + 18 = 108 card Station deck.  That's not going to have the same impact as an alt hero card.

I'm not convinced they'll be bad.  I'm sure they'll be fun.  I'm just a little frustrated and think we can do more, better, Awesomer.  I'll be bummed out if we just manage to get to $65k or $70k by the end, even though that's techincally a win since the project will have been funded.  I want to go all the way!

posts.name: Cosmonaut Zero
posts.cooked:
I actually really appreciated that update. It means that they can get more people playtesting earlier. That means everybody gets a better game in the end. What it says to me is that >G care more about making the best game they can make than posting the highest KS numbers they can post. That's an admirable trait, IMO.

The other half is that a crazily overfunded KS with highly ambitious stretch goals means the game takes longer to make and their margin on each KS copy goes down. The relatively modest stretch goals say to me that >G have a well-scoped game in production and realistic expectations for what they can reasonably provide. There's a reason Shattered Timelines is one of two Kickstarted things I've ever received BEFORE the estimated date.
